numinance.kinds.v1.ExecutorManifest.json.description:
ExecutorManifest declares an author executor: its adapter, capabilities, models and cost class. Profiles select it by metadata.name, the executor id; one adapter ships one manifest per data path.
 Org-scoped only (the loader refuses another metadata.scope); authority only as the manifest pinned with its adapter in
 the lockfile. residency waits for a later minor; a residency class is never declared.

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.ExecutorManifest.json.title: Executor Manifest

numinance.kinds.v1.ExecutorManifestSpec..description:
ExecutorManifestSpec is what the router reads to select an executor for a work unit. Every field is a claim of the
 adapter author; the sandbox, egress proxy and broker enforce the request whatever the manifest says.

capabilities.description: capabilities is required, non-empty and unique; playbook steps require capabilities by name.

models.description: models is required, non-empty and unique by id: the models the executor may run.

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of the authorexecutor adapter, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

numinance.kinds.v1.ExecutorManifestSpec..title: Executor Manifest Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.ExecutorModel.jsonsch.description: ExecutorModel is one model the executor may run; a message, so per-model fields such as residency stay additive.

id.description: id is required: 1 to 253 bytes of ASCII letters, digits, ".", "_", "-", ":", "/" and "@", starting with a letter or digit.

max_context.description: max_context is required and at least 1: the most tokens of context the model accepts in one request.

numinance.kinds.v1.ExecutorModel.jsonsch.title: Executor Model

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
scope.title: Scope

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.title: Metadata
